items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I can't recall who this Bob Williams.

ctx.x: Composers are Bob Williams and Louis Russell. I don't know who Bob Williams is.
Bob Williams, I think... Let's see who Bob Williams was. Bob Williams, Bob Williams. Bob Williams, I think... I can't recall who this Bob Williams.
Well, let's play the other side. Saratoga Drag.
